My workers found a rare ultrasonic thickness gauge at the customs warehouse, along with some equally useful equipment. There's nothing better that can give me that kind of precision in my measurements! I can't risk it, so I'm trusting you with this recovery mission. Pick up the package at Customs and deliver it to the designated point at Polikhim. There's something I've been wanting to test for a while... Wait, you didn't know about the industrial area shortcut? I used it back when I worked at Polikhim. It was the only way to get equipment to the plant that would otherwise be stuck in customs for months. A fellow forester showed me this path. He said that people were afraid to pick mushrooms near the plant, so it was always full of good pickings.}} ==Objectives== * Locate and obtain the [[Case with precision tools|precision tools package]] in the laboratory on [[Customs]] * Use the transit from [[Customs]] to [[Factory]] (In one raid) * Eliminate 3 [[Scavs]] on [[Factory]] (In one raid) * Stash the [[Case with precision tools|package]] at the laboratory storage room on [[Factory]] ==Rewards== * +19,400 [[EXP]] * [[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.03''' * 72,000 Roubles ** 75,600 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 82,800 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[Electric motor]] * 2× [[Power supply unit]] * 3× [[Power cord]] {{quote|You didn't lose anything along the way, correct?
